notes.content: This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s): Take CMST 131 for Oral Communication (1C). Critical Thinking (1B) is waived. Take only one course in either Arts (3A) or Humanities (3B). The other is waived. CIVL 302W (upper division: taken after transfer) fulfills Social and Behavioral Sciences (4).
notes.contentHtml:
This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s):

  • Take CMST 131 for Oral Communication (1C).
  • Critical Thinking (1B) is waived.
  • Take only one course in either Arts (3A) or Humanities (3B). The other is waived.
  • CIVL 302W (upper division: taken after transfer) fulfills Social and Behavioral Sciences (4).

notes.content: Enrollment in any mathematics course requires a grade of C- or higher in all prerequisite courses or their transfer equivalents.
